challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am willing to accept a manual review of the data contracts for the loyalty basket feed. We will lose the speed of automated consent checks, but that is a cost I can absorb if it keeps the weekly leaflet on schedule. The promotion planning cycle cannot stall while we wait for full governance tooling. If the manual process delays the buyer lock, I will not sign off on the trade. I am giving up the robustness of automated enforcement to protect the launch date. That is my limit.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are giving up the robustness of automated enforcement and accepting the loss of speed to protect the launch date, which fits the definition of a trade-off.
